title: Summit orientation deck notes and exec update prep Q3
body:
Purpose
- Rapid draft for the Q3 summit orientation deck and associated exec update notes. Primary audience: execs + ICs attending the internal summit; secondary: wider company via follow-up townhall.
- Goal: align leadership narrative on priorities, surface risks and mitigation, and lock the townhall run-of-show by July 8.

High-level objectives we want the summit to land on
1) Clear product posture: Hosted API growth vs. Dedicated demand — messaging + ask for investment in Dedicated capacity roadmap.
2) Reliability commitments: concrete SLOs and what we will buy (monitoring, SRE hires, runbooks).
3) Cost/Performance play: Optimize recommendations from Redwood Optimize work and next steps for rollout to top 5 customers.
4) People/Org: where to prioritize headcount and micro-org adjustments.

Draft exec narrative (3 slides)
- Slide A: State of the product — quick bullets: usage growth, latency percentiles, top 3 customer wins (anonymized), friction points. One metric per line.
- Slide B: Where we must invest — Dedicate (capacity guarantees), Private (enterprise security), Optimize (cost controls). For each, 1 ask and 1 metric target.
- Slide C: Risks & Mitigation — capacity shortage, model regression after quantization, and onboarding time for Private. For each risk, proposed fallback + owner.

OKR seeds (for discussion)
- Objective: Make inference predictable and economical for enterprise customers.
  - KR1: Reduce P95 latency on Hosted API by 15% for 8k token median workloads (owner: infra).
  - KR2: Ship Dedicated autoscaler v1 and hit 70% utilization efficiency (owner: dedicated).
  - KR3: Rollout Optimize recommendations to top 10 production customers and measure 20% avg token cost reduction (owner: optimize).

Townhall run-of-show (45m total)
- 0-5m: Opening from CEO (state + theme) — ask: one slide, 3 bullet theme. (Owner: CEO)
- 5-15m: Exec update rapid-fire (product, infra, go-to-market) — three short slides, one ask each. (Owners: product, infra, GTM)
- 15-25m: Customer story (pre-recorded) + short Q&A. (CS)
- 25-35m: New policies (Dedicated commitments + SLA changes) — show impact on customers and internal teams. (Product & Legal)
- 35-42m: Live Q&A (moderated via slack thread + live upvotes)
- 42-45m: Close + 3 immediate actions for orgs

Pre-reads and deck requirements
- Pre-read (send 72 hours prior): 2-page one-pager: key metrics + asks + 3 FAQs. (Owner: Aisha)
- Deck: 18 slides max. Keep slide titles short. Add appendix with SLO graphs and rollout plan. (Design owner: Lydia)
- Data cut: include P50/P95 token latency by model family, cost-per-1k tokens trend, Dedicated pool utilization forecast (infra).

Logistics checklist (things that often break)
- AV: Confirm overflow room + livestream encoding settings (Jon).
- Recording: auto-captioning on, store to shared drive, link in follow-up.
- Speaker prep: 1x 20 min dry run with slides + 1x 5 min mic check. Set firm schedule.
- Slide ownership: each speaking exec must own 1-2 slides and a single backup slide in appendix.

Communications plan
- Announcement cadence: save-the-date -> pre-read -> reminder -> townhall -> follow-up.
- Tone: transparent about risks, concrete about asks, emphasize engineering-first wins.
- Post-townhall doc: exec summary + FAQs + action tracker (tracked in JIRA OPS-1427).

Risks & open questions
- Risk: Deck gets too heavy on technical detail and loses exec attention. Mitigation: push detailed SLOs to appendix; use 1 metric per slide.
- Risk: Conflicting asks between product and GTM (budget vs. sales enablement). Mitigation: leadership sync on July 3 to reconcile. (Owner: Marco)
- Open question: Which Dedicated pricing change (if any) do we announce now vs later? Need legal + finance sign-off by July 6.

Action items (owner / due)
- Aisha: compile pre-read and final one-pager (due: 2025-07-03)
- Lydia: design deck master and appendix templates (due: 2025-07-05)
- Jon: AV sign-off and runbook for livestream (due: 2025-07-06)
- Marco: host leadership reconciliation meeting (due: 2025-07-03)
- Priya: draft customer story brief + edit (due: 2025-06-30)

Notes to self (rough)
- Keep slides under 2 minutes each. Audience attention drops after 20m.
- Use customer quotes rather than logos when privacy is a concern.
- Prepare fallback 'status' slide if we need to pivot to crisis-mode messaging.

Appendix ideas (for later)
- SLO trend visualizations (P50, P75, P95) by model family, last 6 months.
- Cost-per-token impact of quantization by model size.
- Staffing roadmap and hiring timeline for SRE and Dedicated ops.

Comments / quick thread: please add direct edits to the deck google slide (link in linked_artifacts) and flag any blocking items in JIRA OPS-1427.

---
Version notes: v0.1 initial compile; v0.2 to incorporate design and legal feedback; target v1.0 (final) by 2025-07-07 for distribution.
